title: Garden Party Pinball
label: pinball machine
summary: I'm building a full-size homebrew pinball machine around FAST control hardware and Mission Pinball Framework. I designed and assembled the cabinet, playfield mechanisms, control board, wiring, and game logic. The machine currently powers up with the playfield installed while I rework the cabinet fit and final geometry.

title: VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm
label: robotics simulation
summary: A ten-person Stanford AI4ALL project combining computer vision, inverse kinematics, and PyBullet simulation to move a robotic arm toward recognized objects.
contribution: I led CAD, modeled the arm in SolidWorks, prepared its URDF files, and worked with a teammate on a physical prototype.

title: Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB
label: plant-watering prototype
summary: I designed and assembled an ESP32-based controller for a self-watering planter. The fabricated PCB reads soil moisture, controls a water pump, and integrates display and physical input hardware. I also designed the planter, reservoir, and electronics layout in SolidWorks.
logo_alt: ExxonMobil Foundation Teen Engineering and Tech Center logo
related_program_note: Well... kinda. Coach Taylor, my ninth grade coach at the TETC challenged me to make this, so while it wasn't a lesson, it has a connection to TETC.

title: Subpix
label: desktop app
summary: I built Subpix, an open-source desktop editor for drawing with individual RGB subpixels. It reads and validates .subpix JSON files, exports PNG images, and ships as a packaged Windows application built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Vite.
